faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Yoga/Sports Teacher/Instructor post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Yoga/Sports Teacher/Instructor post is 31 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduate Degree in Physical Education and a Graduate Degree in Yoga Education or a related field to be eligible for the Yoga/Sports Teacher/Instructor position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 40 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government rules for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Yoga/Sports Teacher/Instructor role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 10,000/- for the Yoga/Sports Teacher/Instructor position.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this government job?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out, and send it to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Yoga/Sports Teacher/Instructor post?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Merit List followed by Document Verification. Candidates are advised to prepare accordingly.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of PM Shri Primary School Deurganv, which is https://bastar.gov.in.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Yoga/Sports Teacher/Instructor in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for this position is Contractual, meaning the appointment will be on a contract basis.
